protocol.title: Common Harbor Ring three-car sandbox

protocol.tacticalLayer: GPT RacecraftAgent, Claude Racecraft, and the pinned Gemini V2 GameTheoreticCombatEngine are called from benchmark-owned checkouts; Gemini branch controller cadence is kept separate in the profiles
protocol.fairness: same track geometry, GT category, car limits, race distance, timestep, starting order rules and telemetry schema for every car
protocol.limitation: This is an adapter comparison, not a claim that incompatible native physics engines are identical. Use the native technical suites for native physics evidence.

sandbox.label: Harbor Ring · three-car shared-physics sandbox
sandbox.sharedPhysics: Every car is integrated by the same deterministic reference physics loop; architecture differences enter through the tactical decision adapter only.
